results.description:
Caregiving involves more than showing up. It means remembering medications, preparing for doctor visits, following up on decisions, tracking changes and keeping family members informed.

Carevation brings the moving pieces of care into one shared place, helping families support an aging parent or other loved one with greater clarity.
Keep everyday care visible.

See upcoming tasks, medications and visits in one place, so you can quickly understand what needs attention.
Make every doctor’s visit count.

Prepare questions before an appointment, take notes or record the conversation with permission, and use Carevation’s Smart features to turn the visit into a clear summary and proposed next steps.

Stay on track with medications.
Maintain an up-to-date medication list, schedule reminders and record whether medications were taken.

Notice changes over time.
Track symptoms, severity and possible triggers so you have a clearer record when speaking with healthcare professionals.

Coordinate with your family.
Assign tasks, share updates and keep care information accessible to the people helping support your loved one.

Keep important information together.
Store care records, provider details, medical history and important files where you can find them when they are needed.

Carevation is designed for family caregivers, including adult children supporting an aging parent, long-distance caregivers and families sharing responsibility across several people.
Key features include:
- Caregiving tasks and assignments
- Doctor-visit preparation and notes
- Smart visit summaries and proposed follow-ups
- Medication lists, reminders and intake tracking
- Symptom tracking and health trends
- Shared family updates
- Care records, files and provider details
- Caregiver check-ins and journaling

Carevation supports care organization and communication. It does not provide medical advice, diagnosis or treatment. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional when making medical decisions.

Some features require a Carevation Premium or Pro subscription. Eligible new subscribers may receive a one-month free trial. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled through your App Store account before the renewal date.

results.description:
Hyey — “Have You Eaten Yet?” — is how so many families say I love you. But when the people who love someone most are spread across different schedules, different cities, and different caregivers, that simple question gets a lot harder to answer. Hyey fixes that.

Hyey is the coordination app built for families managing home care for an aging parent. Whether you’re the primary caregiver or one of several people sharing the load, Hyey gives your whole care team one place to track what’s happening, who did what, and what comes next.

Coordinate your care team: Add family members, home health aides, and anyone else involved in care. Everyone has the information they need to provide the best care.

Track what matters: Log medications, health vitals, mood, sleep, bathroom visits, and daily activities. Know how your loved one is really doing, without having to bother anyone for updates.

Seamless handoffs: Care doesn’t stop when shifts change. Hyey keeps the handoff clean so nothing gets missed between caregivers.

Built by daughters who lived it. Hyey was born from personal experience navigating aging parent care while working full time.

Download Hyey and bring your care team together.

The mission of Eirene Care is to support family caregivers by using technology to design easy-to-use tools that assist them in their day-to-day caregiving responsibilities. This app is specifically focused on facilitating care for individuals with dementia or those undergoing cancer treatment. It allows caregivers to log daily tasks, track any chemo or radiation side effects and manage care plans and appointments. A few high level functions within the app are: 
Live Support: Get immediate assistance through live chat, connecting caregivers with expert support teams for personalized help. The AI assistant is also available 24/7 to offer quick guidance.
Dementia:  Tools to help caregivers record behaviors and activities and manage care for elders with dementia.
Chemotherapy: Track chemotherapy side effects, treatment progress and provide needed care.
Radiation Therapy: Keep track of radiation therapy side effects to provide the prescribed care.
Download the Family Caregiver app today and be empowered for your caregiving tasks.

Caring for an aging parent is one of the hardest things you'll do. tendercare is the front door to elder care. One free place to get organized, prepare for emergencies, and find trusted local help, so you can show up confidently for the people who matter most.

ORGANIZE WHAT MATTERS
Keep medical records, insurance cards, legal documents, and medication lists in one secure Vault. Connect a Medicare account to automatically sync conditions, medications, and doctors. Everything is labeled, organized, and ready when you need it.

BE READY FOR EMERGENCIES
Set up your free tenderID, a fridge decal, and wallet card with a QR code that gives first responders instant access to your loved one's critical information. First responders get what they need immediately, no app required on their end. You're alerted right away.

KNOW WHAT TO DO NEXT
Not sure where to start? tendercare builds a personalized tendercare Plan based on your loved one's situation, so you have clear next steps, not open questions.

FIND TRUSTED LOCAL HELP
The tendercare Trusted Network of vetted elder care providers. Tell us what you need help with, and we connect you with 441,000+ professionals across 20+ categories in all 50 states. Every Verified Member has earned their place through 20+ hours of vetting across track record, licensure, insurance, and reputation.

STAY ON TOP OF IT TOGETHER
Get proactive reminders for appointments, renewals, and next steps. Invite siblings or other caregivers so everyone sees the same information and nothing gets missed.

CONNECT WITH FREE AND COVERED SUPPORT
We help you find and sign up for Medicare-covered support programs your family may qualify for.

PRIVATE AND SECURE
tendercare is HIPAA-aligned and uses bank-level encryption. Your information is never sold, shared, or used for advertising. Free for families, always.

results.description:
Somehow you became the one who keeps track of it all — the pills, the appointments, who said they'd stop by. When a parent is getting older, a partner is in treatment, or someone you love needs care every day, it almost always lands on one person: you.

CircleCare shares the load. Create one care circle around the person you care for, invite the people who help, and everyone works from the same up-to-date picture, whether they live down the street or across the country.

EVERYONE ON THE SAME PAGE
- Medications, appointments, tasks and notes in one shared place
- See who did what: who gave a dose, who finished a task, who left a note
- The activity feed shows every update from everyone in the circle, so nobody has to ask "did anyone check?"
- With reminders on, if a dose isn't marked in time, the alert goes to the person taking it, then to the caregivers, then to the whole circle

MEDICATIONS, SHARED
- Daily, weekly or custom schedules, with reminders
- Mark a dose taken or skipped, and the whole circle sees it
- New: as-needed medications. Log a dose when it's given, like a pain reliever, and everyone can see when the last one was given and by whom

APPOINTMENTS AND TASKS
- One shared calendar for doctor visits, treatments and tests
- Assign tasks and appointments to someone, or leave them open for whoever can help
- Add notes and questions so the next person knows what happened

NEW: THE DAILY UPDATE
Each evening at 7 pm, the Home screen shows a short summary of what the circle logged that day. If something was logged, you get one quiet notification, with no health details in it. It's free, and you can turn it off.

HEALTH INFO WHEN IT MATTERS
Allergies, conditions, doctors, insurance and emergency contacts in one place, ready to share as text or a PDF. Keep documents like test results and insurance cards with the circle too.

FREE TO START, FAIR AS YOUR TEAM GROWS
Free: 1 care circle for you + 1 caregiver. The person you care for can join too and doesn't count toward that. Medications and reminders are free forever. No credit card needed.

Premium, for families with more helping hands:
- Unlimited family members: everyone who helps, in one circle
- Add by voice: say a medication, task or appointment and we fill in the form for you to check. On supported phones.
- Adherence reports to share with doctors, plus calendar import
- 1 GB of documents per circle
- AI care assistant
- Up to 5 care circles

Monthly or yearly, priced fairly for your country. Yearly includes a free trial. Only the person who creates the circle pays. Invited family members never pay.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
This is your family's health information, not ad data. No ads. We never sell your data. Only the people you invite can see your circle.

IN 8 LANGUAGES
English, Spanish, French, French (Canada), German, Italian, Portuguese (Brazil) and Portuguese (Portugal). Everyone chooses their own.

GET STARTED IN A FEW MINUTES
Create a care circle, add a medication or an appointment, and invite your family. Nobody should have to carry this alone.

Terms of Use: https://circlecare.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://circlecare.app/privacy/

Caring for someone you love, together with your family? With CareWall everyone knows what is going on and who does what, without endless messages and loose lists.

ONE CARE CIRCLE, EVERYONE IN THE LOOP
Create a care circle for your mother, father, grandma or grandpa and invite the family. Everyone sees the same: what happens today, what still needs doing and how things are going.

results.description:
Caring Village is the all-in-one app for family caregivers. Coordinate medications, schedules, tasks, and documents — and keep your whole care circle in the loop — without the chaos of texts, spreadsheets, and missed calls. Whether you're managing an aging parent's care from across the country or coordinating with siblings across town, Caring Village keeps everyone on the same page.

Why Caring Village?

Caregiving is rarely one person's job — but it often ends up that way. Multiple schedules, medications to track, documents to find, decisions to make together. Caring Village brings it all into one secure, family-focused platform so you can spend less time managing logistics and more time being present.

Key Features:

Julia – Your AI Caregiving Assistant
Meet Julia, your AI-powered caregiving assistant. Available anytime, Julia answers questions, offers guidance, and helps families make more informed decisions throughout the caregiving journey.

Advanced Medication Management
Set detailed medication reminders, track adherence, and share updates with your care circle. No more wondering if a dose was taken.

Shared Care Calendar
Keep everyone aligned with a shared calendar that syncs with external calendars so appointments don't slip through the cracks.

Printable Care Calendar
Export and print calendars for offline use or to share with doctors and family members.

Task Lists
Create and assign tasks to care circle members. Family members can volunteer for responsibilities — so caregiving is shared, not shouldered alone.

Expert-Curated Checklists
Access checklists built by caregiving experts to guide you through complex situations, from daily routines to emergency planning.

Customizable Care Plans
Design care plans tailored to your loved one's specific needs, with flexible reminders to stay on track.

Wellness Journal
Track moods, symptoms, and milestones. Share photos and updates with your care circle, where family members can like, comment, and stay emotionally connected — even from a distance.

Secure Document Storage
Store and organize medical records, insurance forms, and legal documents in one secure hub. Everything in one place when you need it most.

Built for Families Who Share the Load

Caregiving doesn't have to fall on one person. Caring Village makes it easy for your whole family to step in — volunteer for tasks, track medications, read updates — so the load is shared and nothing gets missed. Whether your family lives under one roof or across time zones, you'll have the tools to stay aligned, divide responsibilities, and show up for each other.

Who Is Caring Village For?


Family caregivers supporting aging parents
Spouses and partners managing chronic conditions
Families coordinating care across multiple households
Anyone who wants to get organized and share the caregiving load


Over 85,000 families use Caring Village to coordinate care and keep everyone in it.

Download today and see what organized caregiving looks like.

Brelti is a care coordination app designed to help families manage the complex, everyday work of caregiving—together, in one place.

Created by caregivers, Brelti brings your entire care team, important information, and daily tasks into a single, organized system—making care easier to coordinate and easier to sustain.

With Brelti, you can:
• Organize medical, legal, financial, and personal documents in one secure vault
• Coordinate care across family members and caregivers with shared access
• Track medications, conditions, allergies, and appointments
• Record and transcribe phone calls and conversations for future reference
• Discover and manage providers, including doctors, specialists, and services
• Stay on top of daily check-ins, reminders, and care updates
• Sync Brelti's in-app calendar to Google, Outlook, and Apple, to make sure that everyone is on the same page, everywhere.

AI-POWERED ASSISTANCE, BUILT FOR REAL CARE
Brelti includes Bella, an AI-powered care assistant that helps you handle routine coordination tasks using natural language. You can ask Bella to:
• Schedule appointments and create calendar events
• Find nearby providers and store their information
• Upload and organize documents
• Manage medications and care notes
• Search across your stored medical records and files

Bella is designed to support organization and coordination—not to provide medical advice or diagnoses.

A VAULT THAT GOES BEYOND MEDICAL RECORDS
Unlike simple “medical binder” apps, Brelti’s vault is built for the full reality of caregiving. You can store and organize documents across multiple categories, including medical records, insurance, legal paperwork, financial documents, housing information, identity documents, notes, and recordings—all in one place.

BUILT FOR TEAMS, NOT JUST INDIVIDUALS
Care rarely falls on one person alone. Brelti lets you invite family members and caregivers, switch between care recipients, and keep everyone aligned without relying on scattered texts, emails, or notes apps.

DESIGNED WITH ACCESSIBILITY AND TRUST IN MIND
Brelti is built to be accessible and easy to use, with support for assistive technologies and clear, readable interfaces. Information entered into the app is provided by users and managed according to our privacy practices.
